channel.title: Crypto Front Page
channel.description: Crypto Front Page reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto industry.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2 billion in Binance hack crypto
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, while recovery efforts continue.

item.title: Injective’s Veyra upgrade enters vote before Nov. 24 target
item.description: Injective opened a governance vote on Veyra, a proposed v1.21.0 upgrade that would halt the chain at block 193,145,000 on Nov. 24 if approved.

item.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all users
item.description: Chainalysis says an attacker exposed names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users, prompting account resets and a staged shutdown of its tools.

item.title: Deutsche Bank custody service goes live for paying clients
item.description: Deutsche Bank's custody service is live for paying European clients, holding keys for selected crypto assets as it explores tokenized products.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a blockchain route for participating issuers and acquirers to settle obligations in stablecoins, with privacy tools planned for later.

item.title: Avalanche named ledger for NYSE-affiliated tokenized market
item.description: Ava Labs says Avalanche will provide the ledger for clearing trades on an NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities venue designed to trade and settle around the clock.

item.title: Coinbase’s National Trust Charter Takes Effect
item.description: Coinbase’s national trust company took effect under OCC oversight, bringing crypto custody into a federal framework while keeping the charter’s scope narrow.

item.title: Fed and OCC ask banks about systems after Binance hack
item.description: The Fed and OCC asked banks about unusual activity after Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, turning a crypto breach into a check on possible links to banking.

item.title: FinCEN orders U.S. transfer cutoff for MEXC
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. financial firms to block transfers involving MEXC after alleging $16.7 billion in illicit flows; the order takes effect after publication.

item.title: Consensys launches stack to coordinate settlement across ledgers
item.description: Consensys launched a stack to route transactions across institutional ledgers, coordinating settlement while assets stay native and institutions retain control.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, cutting target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, targeting 25-second blocks and capping shielded activity to speed payments while reducing wallet scan work.

item.title: Why a shiba swap trade can stay pending
item.description: A shiba swap trade has no fixed wait: its timing depends on wallet approval, network fees, blockchain processing and whether the contract call succeeds.

item.title: Hong Kong passes crypto tax reporting law for 2027
item.description: Hong Kong passed a bill requiring covered crypto providers to collect customer and transaction data from 2027, with tax information exchanges due to start in 2028.

item.title: How attackers drained $6.3 billion from Binance
item.description: Attackers drained about $6.3 billion from Binance wallets on Oct. 29 by abusing transaction-signing systems, exposing how exchange controls can fail at scale.

item.title: Polygon bridge transfers: when tokens become usable
item.description: A Polygon bridge deposit locks tokens on Ethereum and mints a matching balance on Polygon; withdrawals burn that balance, wait for a checkpoint, then require a claim.

item.title: Binance says hot-wallet breach moved $6.34bn in assets
item.description: Binance says an attacker moved $6.34bn through its hot-wallet signing system; the exchange has replenished 98% and is reopening withdrawals in phases.

item.title: Mercado Bitcoin Says It Will Cover $38M Security Loss
item.description: Mercado Bitcoin says it will cover about $38 million lost in a security incident, while investigators and crypto firms have frozen some stolen assets.

item.title: Binance reopens withdrawals as $4.72bn leaves after hack
item.description: Binance resumed withdrawals after a $6.3 billion wallet breach, but customers have taken out $4.72 billion, leaving access and security under scrutiny.

item.title: Binance schedules phased withdrawals after $6.3bn breach
item.description: Binance began restoring withdrawals in phases after a breach with an estimated $6.3 billion impact, while the exchange says it will cover losses.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with direct validator votes and certificates that target transaction finality in about 150 milliseconds.
